notes: Only these failure kinds count as the service failing: server_error (HTTP 5xx), timeout, network (no connection) and throttled (open question for the advisors: AWS throttles heavily while recovering). client_error (HTTP 4xx such as bad credentials) proves the service answered, so it counts as unusable, never as down.
A network's minute counts only if its control check (a site outside AWS) succeeded; otherwise the probe itself was down.
Networks are counted by operator, not by name: GitHub Actions runs on Microsoft Azure, so github and azure together count once.
A service-minute is DOWN when at least operators_required operators see the check fail. It is UNKNOWN when fewer than operators_required operators have usable data.
An outage starts at the first DOWN minute and ends after recovery_minutes consecutive minutes that are not DOWN. UNKNOWN minutes inside an outage do not end it.
Regional outage (v1): any of the listed services is DOWN. Single availability-zone events are out of scope until Q1.
